parameters.content:
## ▶ Watch video

Click this node after a run to watch the finished video **inline** — n8n renders
the `video/mp4` binary with a player and a download button, so there is no URL
to copy. One item per rendered opening.

*Rendered row report* before it still carries `videoUrl` for piping onward (see
the publish-tail note).

## We're hiring — a video for every job opening

Add a row to a Google Sheet, get back a polished 1080x1920 hiring video: hero
footage + "WE'RE HIRING" + the role title, a dark offer scene with up to three
perk cards and the salary, and an apply CTA. Vertical, so it works on LinkedIn,
Instagram, TikTok and Shorts as-is. The finished URL is written back to the
sheet, so a row is only ever rendered once.

### Setup (about five minutes)

1. **Zvid API key** — create one at https://app.zvid.io/api-keys
   Add an n8n **Header Auth** credential: name `x-api-key`, value = your key.
   Attach it to *Validate render (free)*, *Save draft to editor*, *Submit render*
   and *Get render status*.
2. **Google Sheets** — attach your Google credential to *Read job openings* AND
   *Write VideoUrl to sheet*, then pick your spreadsheet + tab in both nodes
   (they ship unselected on purpose). Columns are on the sheet note below.
3. **Open `Company Config`** — company name, brand colours, optional logo URL,
   hero video, music, CTA copy. Every knob lives here; no magic values are
   buried in expressions.
4. Run **Test manually** once. The shipped default is `dryRun: false`, so this
   **renders for real and spends credits** — about 12 per opening, up to
   `maxPerRun` (3) openings per run. Click **▶ Watch video** to play the result
   inside n8n.
   *Want a free preview first?* Set `dryRun: true` in `Company Config` before you
   run: every open row is validated and saved as a FREE draft with an editor link
   + the exact credit quote, and nothing is charged. Set it back to `false` to
   render.
5. **Activate the schedule** once you are happy with the look.

### Cost

One ~12 second 1080x1920 video is about **12 credits**. *Validate render (free)*
still returns that exact per-row quote before every render — it is just no longer
a stopping point. Free accounts include enough credits to test.

## The job-openings sheet

Header row (exact names, one opening per row):

`Role | Team | Location | SalaryRange | Perk1 | Perk2 | Perk3 | ApplyUrl | VideoUrl`

- **Role and ApplyUrl are required** — rows missing either are skipped.
- **VideoUrl stays empty** — the workflow only picks rows where it is blank and
  writes the finished MP4 URL there. Clear the cell to re-render an opening.
  At most `maxPerRun` rows are processed per run.
- Perk2 / Perk3 may be empty — the perk cards adapt (0–3 cards).
- ApplyUrl is DISPLAYED on the video, so a short address reads best
  (`acme.com/careers` beats a 70-character tracking link — long ones wrap).

## One designed template, adaptive type

The look is adapted from Zvid's hr-were-hiring / hr-job-opening library
examples: hero video under a gradient scrim + hairline frame, accent kicker
pill, numbered perk cards, a salary pill and a glow CTA with a circled check.

**Type sizes adapt to the text.** A 70-character role title steps down through
five font sizes instead of overflowing; the salary pill and perk cards do the
same, so "Competitive + meaningful equity" fits as cleanly as "€85k–€110k".

Colours (`accentColor`, `backgroundColor`), font, kicker and CTA copy are all
Company Config knobs. Set `companyLogoUrl` to swap the wordmark for a logo
image. The hero clip and music are stock defaults — replace either with your
own brand asset by URL. A music track that is unreachable or over ~5 MB (the
free plan's audio cap) is dropped automatically instead of failing the render.

## Dry run — the free opt-in, not the default

The shipped default is `dryRun: false`: rows go straight down the render branch
and credits are spent.

Set `dryRun: true` in **Company Config** and every open row stops here instead —
the payload is validated, saved as a **draft**, and reported with an editor link
like `https://editor.zvid.io/?project=prj_...` plus the exact credit cost.
Nothing is charged.

Open the link, watch the video back, tweak anything by hand. When it looks right,
set `dryRun` back to `false` — same rows, real renders, URLs written back to the
sheet.

## Publish tail: LinkedIn, Blotato, anywhere

After a live run the sheet holds a ready-to-post MP4 URL per opening. Two easy
tails to bolt onto *Rendered row report*:

- **LinkedIn node** (OAuth2 credential): add an HTTP Request node that downloads
  `videoUrl` (response format: *File*), then a LinkedIn → Create Post node with
  the binary + caption. Build the caption from `role` and the apply link, e.g.
  "We're hiring: {{role}} — apply at ...".
- **Blotato** (or any cross-poster with an HTTP API): skip the download and POST
  `videoUrl` straight to its post endpoint with one HTTP Request node — it
  fetches the video itself and can fan out to LinkedIn, X, TikTok and Instagram.

Keep the first runs manual: post one, check how it looks in the feed, then
automate. The report item also carries `sheetRow` and `jobId` if you want to
log posts back to the sheet.

## Official Zvid nodes

These HTTP Request nodes are deliberately core-only so the workflow runs
anywhere, including n8n Cloud with nothing installed.

On self-hosted n8n you can install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`**
(Settings → Community nodes) and swap them for native nodes:

| HTTP Request node | Native replacement |
| --- | --- |
| Validate render (free) | **Zvid** → Render → Validate |
| Submit render | **Zvid** → Render → Create |
| Get render status + Wait | **Zvid Trigger** (render webhook) |

The Zvid Trigger removes the polling loop entirely.
